evals.prompt: Write me a LinkedIn post about how AI Overviews are killing organic traffic for SEO professionals. I've seen my clients lose 30-40% CTR in the last 6 months and want to share this with my network.
evals.expected_output: A LinkedIn post with: strong hook referencing the CTR drop, 3-5 scraped sources cited in research, storytelling arc showing before/after, specific data points, engagement CTA, 3-5 SEO hashtags. Plus an engagement analysis scorecard.

assertions.name: has-hook-line
assertions.description: Post opens with a strong hook (not starting with 'I'), under 15 words

assertions.name: has-sources-cited
assertions.description: At least 3 authoritative sources were scraped and referenced in the research summary

assertions.name: has-hashtags
assertions.description: Post includes 3-5 relevant hashtags at the end

assertions.name: has-cta
assertions.description: Post ends with a specific question CTA (not just 'thoughts?')

assertions.name: has-engagement-scorecard
assertions.description: Skill produces an engagement analysis with numerical scores (1-10) across at least 4 dimensions

assertions.name: word-count-appropriate
assertions.description: Post body is between 120-280 words (LinkedIn sweet spot)

evals.prompt: I want a LinkedIn post about how I use Claude and ChatGPT in my daily work life as a digital marketer. Something authentic and relatable — not just a list of tools.
evals.expected_output: A personal, first-person LinkedIn post with a narrative/storytelling angle about AI in daily professional life. Should feel authentic, reference real use cases, include scraped data on AI adoption in the workplace, and have a CTA inviting the audience to share their own experience.

assertions.name: has-hook-line
assertions.description: Post opens with a strong hook that is not a generic statement

assertions.name: has-sources-cited
assertions.description: Research phase surfaced at least 3 sources on AI productivity/daily use

assertions.name: has-personal-narrative
assertions.description: Post uses first-person voice and includes a concrete personal scenario or workflow

assertions.name: has-hashtags
assertions.description: Post includes 3-5 appropriate hashtags from the ai-life hashtag bank

assertions.name: has-engagement-scorecard
assertions.description: Engagement analysis scorecard is present with scores and a rewrite suggestion

evals.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about vibe coding. I built a full internal dashboard in one weekend using Claude Code and zero prior React experience. Want to share it but not sound too braggy.
evals.expected_output: A humble-brag style LinkedIn post about vibe coding, grounded in the user's real story. Should use a Before/After/Bridge narrative, reference scraped data on non-programmers building with AI, include specific details about what was built, and invite others to share their own AI building experiences.

assertions.name: has-hook-line
assertions.description: Opening line is punchy and references vibe coding or building without experience

assertions.name: has-sources-cited
assertions.description: Research phase surfaced at least 3 sources on vibe coding or AI development trends

assertions.name: uses-before-after-structure
assertions.description: Post has a clear before/after narrative structure showing contrast

assertions.name: has-hashtags
assertions.description: Post includes VibeCoding or related hashtags

assertions.name: has-engagement-scorecard
assertions.description: Engagement scorecard is present with an A/B test suggestion for an alternate hook

assertions.name: not-braggy-tone
assertions.description: Post tone is humble/curious rather than boastful — invites rather than lectures
